description: LiveCodeBench style (Python): an original interval problem with a twist on the classic merge. Bookings are half-open with weights; blocks form under an inclusive gap tolerance measured from the furthest end so far; each block reports the peak weight active at one instant, where touching bookings are never concurrent. Hidden edges cover nested and unsorted input, zero-length bookings that are ignored but validated, zero weights, float coordinates, a randomized comparison against a pairwise reference and a 60000 interval input that rules out a quadratic scan.
